title: Yoto App updates
body:
See the features for the latest update we have made to the Yoto app, as well as all the previous updates.


Tip: you can check which version of the Yoto app you have by going to the Menu tab (in the app) where it is listed at  the bottom of the screen. 


Yoto app updates

We release updates for the app regularly, bringing in new features, optimising performance and squishing bugs that come along from time to time. It's probably a good idea to switch on auto updates for the app, if you don't have this already.


Yoto app reviews

We really appreciate your app reviews and feedback. If you love our updates, please do leave a review in the app stores.

iPhone: https://apps.apple.com/app/yoto-music-stories-learning/id1412039719

Android: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.yotoplay.yoto


Yoto app (Beta)

We make an app beta available for external testing before we promote the new release to the app stores. Whilst we test extensively and endeavour to ensure the app operates in beta without issues, there are times when glitches may arise. Participating in the app beta gives you access to new features ahead of time but with the caveat that there may be glitches that we haven't spotted. If you let us know at hello@yotoplay.com we can quickly put it right. To participate in the Yoto app beta, you can sign up via one of these links:

iPhone: https://testflight.apple.com/join/di4bwD5z

Android: https://play.google.com/apps/testing/com.yotoplay.yoto

Yoto App v2.26 (6th May 2021)

  • Setup Improvements: including adding more specific details to our troubleshooting screens to make them more likely to solve real world setup issues. These updates are based on ongoing research and development we do in order to continually improve the setup process for Yoto Player.
  • Sharing Playlists for MYO: we have expanded the beta trial of the new sharing feature so that more people can try this out and let us know how it’s working for them. Simply tap the three dot menu within any Make Your Own playlist and see the option to ‘Share with Friends & Family’.
  • Disconnect Wi-Fi: we have reinstated the option to disconnect Yoto Player from your Wi-Fi network (in the Manage Wi-Fi section), which we had inadvertently removed at the same time as adding the option to add a new Wi-Fi network in the last app release.
  • Leave a Family Account: we have added the option to leave a Family Account from within the Players tab. Previously, to ‘leave’ an account, you had to be ‘removed’ by another User in the same Family Account, which seemed odd to us when we thought about it.

Yoto App v2.25 (3rd May 2021)

  • Setup Improvements: including adding more specific details to our troubleshooting screens to make them more likely to solve real world setup issues. These updates are based on ongoing research and development we do in order to continually improve the setup process for Yoto Player.
  • Sharing Playlists for MYO: we have expanded the beta trial of the new sharing feature so that more people can try this out and let us know how it’s working for them. Simply tap the three dot menu within any Make Your Own playlist and see the option to ‘Share with Friends & Family’.
  • Disconnect Wi-Fi: we have reinstated the option to disconnect Yoto Player from your Wi-Fi network (in the Manage Wi-Fi section), which we had inadvertently removed at the same time as adding the option to add a new Wi-Fi network in the last app release.
  • Leave a Family Account: we have added the option to leave a Family Account from within the Players tab. Previously, to ‘leave’ an account, you had to be ‘removed’ by another User in the same Family Account, which seemed odd to us when we thought about it.

Yoto App v2.24 (7th April 2021)

  • Adding new Wi-Fi network details is now clearer to do, as it happens in the Manage Wi-Fi section of Player Settings. Previously you had to ‘Set up a Yoto Player’ when you wanted to get your Player online at a new location, or if you changed your Wi-Fi password or provider, which was confusing.
  • Card running times are now shown on the card detail screen (to add to the track/chapter lengths that were added in the previous release).
  • Haptic feedback (nice little vibrations that help indicate buttons have been pushed) has been added to the main play/stop buttons
  • We have added a direct link to the Make Your Own section of the app from the landing screen, for people using the app for the first time who may only be interested in creating their own content to share with family (grandparents, aunts, uncles for example)

  • Track Lengths: we have added track lengths on the card detail screen, so you can… see how long the tracks are! And we’ll be making further improvements to this area in future releases, too.
  • ‘Players’ tab: we have changed the name of the old ‘Account’ tab to ‘Players’ as you told us that the old name was somewhat confusing. We think this is a better way to describe this, as the main reason for using this screen is to manage your Yoto Player settings.

Yoto App v2.17 (11th November 2020)

  • Audio Record: Now you can record your own audio directly in the app, to make playlists you can link to cards to play on Yoto Player! No need to mess around with a 3rd party voice memo app, it all now happens in the Yoto app.

    Grandparents can make recordings which you can link to cards remotely for the kids. They just need to download the app, follow the “Set up a Yoto Player” steps (getting you to press the buttons and tell them the code over the phone if they can’t be there in person), and join your Family Account.

    All playlists they make will now be visible in your app.

Yoto App v2.16 (23rd October 2020)

  • Sleep Sounds: an exciting new feature coming to Yoto, Sleep Sounds is an addition to the My Library section of the app, and contains a selection of sounds to help sooth the restless when it’s time for bed. From White Noise, to Thundery Rain, to the gentle sound of a Devon Hedgerow. You can play these tracks from the app directly on your phone, or remotely through Yoto Player, or you can link them to a Make Your Own card in the normal way.
  • Yoto Sleep Radio: within the Sleep Sounds area of the app, we have introduced a new radio station playing a selection of tracks for a calm and soothing bedtime. You can play this station from the app directly on your phone, or remotely through Yoto Player, or you can link it to a Make Your Own card in the normal way.
  • Other fixes and improvements: layout tweaks for phones of different sizes, and more guidance on setting up Yoto Player to your Wi-Fi network when you have a network name (SSID) longer than 31 characters.
